correctness.rationale: The source proof handles every P and arbitrary W: a violation consists of unequal intersecting nonsingleton classes A,B; P={w∈A∩B} deletes one class first, and a vertex in the nonempty difference survives only the opposite order. Under the criterion each deleted mixed E-class is a union of intact F-classes (and vice versa), so the second test preserves exactly the originally F-homogeneous surviving classes. Counting compatible classes as disjoint >=2 blocks colored E-only,F-only,both gives EGF. Independently enumerated every ordered pair of set partitions and all atomic valuations on n=1,...,5, obtaining 1,4,13,61,304 compatible pairs and zero equivalence failures. These finite tests corroborate, but do not replace, the infinite set-theoretic proof. Three worlds is the sharp obstruction.
